brainlife.desc: Deprecated white matter classification: output.mat with classification and fibre group (FG) streamlines, plus optional counts, tract JSON and surfaces.
brainlife.name: neuro/wmc-deprecated

original.desc: White Matter Classification and FG structure

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Conversion to the current neuro/wmc datatype.

**Not for:** New analyses; convert to neuro/wmc first.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App, output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.wmc-deprecated.json

files.desc: MATLAB file with the classification and embedded fibre groups.
Text file of streamline counts per tract.
Per-tract JSON files for the viewer.
Surface meshes of associated ROIs for the viewer.

identifying_risks: Individual white matter geometry can support re-linkage as a structural fingerprint
Headers and metadata may carry subject codes or acquisition dates
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level processed neurodata without direct identifiers. Tier 4 conditions apply if used as a connectome fingerprint.
sharing_cautions: Share with coded subject IDs under a data use agreement
Strip free-text tags and dates from metadata before release
tier_conditions: Tier 1 only once aggregated across participants (e.g. a population atlas)
Tier 4 if used to build connectome fingerprints or predictive features

intended_use: Conversion to the current neuro/wmc datatype.
not_suitable_for: New analyses; convert to neuro/wmc first.

outputs_of.name: Posterior Associative White Matter Tracts Segmentation
